item.title: Magnetic Fidget Sliders Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys; Sold on Amazon by PIXLABBY
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from October 2025 through May 2026 for about $10.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from October 2025 through May 2026 for about $10.
item.product: PIXLABBY Silicone Sensory Magnetic Fidget Sliders
item.summary: This recall involves PIXLABBY's 6-PCS silicone magnetic fidget sliders. The fidget sliders come in various two-tone colors, yellow/red, pink/yellow, orange/purple, blue/orange, green/blue, and red/green. Each slider has a different silicone texture on the top and bottom surfaces. The fidget sliders make a clicking sound as you slide them. The "PIXABBY" logo is on the front of the box.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: PIXLABBY Silicone Sensory Magnetic Fidget Sliders.
item.remedy: Consumers should take the fidget sliders away from children, stop using them immediately and contact PIXLABBY for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to throw away the fidget sliders and submit a photo of the disposed toys to ah1998zxc@gmail.com to receive a refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
